title: Finite Expression Method with TranNet-based Function Learning for High-Dimensional Partial Differential Equations
summary: In this paper, we study a machine-learning-based solver for high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs). Computing accurate solutions efficiently for such problems remains challenging because of the curse of dimensionality, which severely limits the scalability of classical numerical methods. Our approach builds on the recently developed finite expression method (FEX), which approximates PDE solutions in a function space generated by finitely many analytic expressions.
